messages:
sam: Kicking off the region-by-region preflight. Plan: US canary -> wait 20m -> EU canary -> wait 20m -> APAC ramp.
marta: Copy. US canary scheduled for 09:30 PT. Can we confirm warm pool numbers and quota cushion?
jess: Oncall here — monitoring dashboards up. Need PS for rollback thresholds.
infra-bot: Warm pools: us-east-1=120 GPU pods idle, eu-west-1=80 GPU pods idle, ap-southeast-1=40 GPU pods idle. Reserved burst cushion=15%.
sam: Nice. Deploybot will pin model v2.8.1-canary to the canary slice. If pinned variant fails, fallback to v2.8.0.
deploy-bot: Starting canary roll for service=inference-api region=us-east-1 version=v2.8.1-canary weight=1% slots=3
marta: Smoke tests to run: endpoint sanity, 95p latency, token error rate, kv-cache hit rate.
ops-bot: Smoke test run queued. Will post results in ~6m.
sam: Rollback criteria (draft):
- error rate spike: >1.5% sustained over 5m
- 95th pct latency >500ms over 5m
- kv-cache miss rate increase >10% relative baseline
If any one triggers, we stop rollout and rollback to pinned version.
jess: Add: request-level QoS breaches (timeouts >3s) for more than 1% of requests for 3m should be included.
devin: Can we also gate on capacity headroom? If tail dispatch queues >2000 in region for 3m, hold.
infra-bot: Current tail queue: us-east-1=120, eu-west-1=30, ap-southeast-1=12.
marta: Good. Ops will monitor heatmap and 1-click rollback signal.
ops-bot: Smoke tests done — all green.
ops-bot: Metrics snapshot (US canary): 95p latency=320ms, error_rate=0.2%, kv_cache_hit=88%.
sam: Proceeding to increase canary to 5% for next 10m. Watch for behavioral regressions and hallucination rate on eval prompts.
deploy-bot: Updating weight -> 5% region=us-east-1
marta: Reminder: don't exceed reserved capacity cushion. If usage peaks above 85% of reserved pool, throttle the canary.
sam: Noted. Also pin routing: EU will use v2.8.1-canary only if US 5% for 10m has no rollback signals.
jess: Logging checklist: snapshot prompts set, saved eval set=v2-internal/canary-run-2026-03-21, alerts bound to channel #incidents and mobile pings.
ops-bot: Canary watch: 10m window started.
(8m later)
ops-bot: 5m rolling stats: error_rate=0.4%, 95p_latency=340ms, kv_cache_hit=86% — within thresholds.
sam: Go to EU canary at 12:00 UTC (will convert to local in calendar). Confirmed.
marta: EU staged deploybot start queued. Notifying EU oncall.
ops-bot: deploy-bot will start EU canary in 3m.
deploy-bot: Starting canary roll for service=inference-api region=eu-west-1 version=v2.8.1-canary weight=1% slots=2
ops-bot: EU smoke initial: 95p_latency=410ms, error_rate=0.6%, kv_cache_hit=83%.
jess: EU 95p is higher but under 500ms. Keep close eye.
devin: Capacity headroom EU now at 70% reserved used after canary slice. Still under 85%.
sam: Increase EU to 3% for 15m. If tail queue >500 for 5m, hold and inform infra.
deploy-bot: Updating weight -> 3% region=eu-west-1
ops-bot: EU 10m stats: 95p_latency=430ms, error_rate=0.9% (mostly short retries), kv_cache_hit=82%.
marta: We're approaching heuristic: error_rate creeping. Ops, do we have a quick diff on request shapes vs baseline? Could be longer contexts.
ops-bot: Noted — diff shows mean tokens/request +12% in EU canary vs baseline.
sam: That may explain latency. Reduce canary to 1% and increase logging. Hold EU ramp until token distribution accounted.
deploy-bot: Reducing weight -> 1% region=eu-west-1
marta: Agree on logging. Also check quantization fallback path — if kernel selection uses slower path, that's bad.
infra-bot: Kernel trace: EU canary used fallback kernel on 2% of requests due to seq_len>1024.
sam: Okay, new plan: pin EU to 1% and skip APAC for now until we confirm sequence-length fixes. Notify APAC leads.
jess: I'll open a short incident doc if we see error_rate >1.5% or latency >600ms.
marta: Notifying APAC: defer until we get a green re-run. APAC warm pool flagged but will stay idle.
ops-bot: Final US snapshot before EU hold: 95p_latency=330ms, error_rate=0.3%, kv_cache_hit=87% — canary stable.
sam: Thanks everyone. Action items: devin/infra to investigate seq_len fallback and kernel selection; marta to schedule a re-run in 2 hours; ops to keep alerts on. If EU stable for 30m at 1% with no regression, pick APAC trial at 0.5%.
devin: On it — starting kernel trace and model CFG audit.
marta: I'll prep release notes blurb explaining gradual rollout + automatic fallback and rollback thresholds.
(20m later)
infra-bot: Kernel patch deployed to eu-west-1 runtime test slot. Will run targeted QA.
ops-bot: EU re-run (1%): 95p_latency=350ms, error_rate=0.4%, kv_cache_hit=88%.
sam: Looks good. Proceed to APAC 0.5% if infra confirms full kernel rollout.
infra-bot: Kernel fully rolled to eu-west-1. APAC slot warm pool still at 38 pods.
deploy-bot: Starting canary roll for service=inference-api region=ap-southeast-1 version=v2.8.1-canary weight=0.5% slots=1
ops-bot: APAC initial: 95p_latency=470ms, error_rate=0.2%, kv_cache_hit=84%.
jess: APAC 95p close to 500ms, but still under. Keep monitor for 10m.
(after 12m)
ops-bot: APAC 10m: 95p=490ms, error_rate=0.25%.
sam: All regions stable at their canary weights. I'll start a gradual ramp plan in 2h with sequential 10% increments per region if no regressions.
marta: I'll update the release notes and post to #release-announce with rollback criteria and pinned fallback info.
sam: Great. Final reminder: if any region hits rollback signal, urgent all-hands in #release-war-room and deploy-bot will auto-pin to previous stable.
ops-bot: Acknowledged. Monitoring will escalate.
jess: Thanks team :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: slack threads about regional rollout and capacity checks
